If we interpret the difference quotient as an average rate of change (Section 2.1), the derivative gives the function’s instantaneous rate of change with respect to x at the point
x = x0. We study this interpretation in Section 3.4.

Summary
We have been discussing slopes of curves, lines tangent to a curve, the rate of change of a function, and the derivative of a function at a point. All of these ideas refer to the same limit.
